title: PropertiesPanel: add rotation/scale inputs to ShapeView, BitmapView, VideoView
description: packages/authoring-ui/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx ShapeView (lines 393-663), BitmapView (lines 1410-1522), and VideoView (lines 1529-1618) all show x, y and W/H but none expose rotation or scaleX/scaleY as writable numeric inputs. These are standard Flash 8 properties panel fields. Fix: add rotation (degrees) and scaleX/scaleY (%) numeric inputs to each of these three view types, wired to the same mutation callbacks.
